data.one_liner: Automatically generate index / barrel / library files with all exports needed.
data.what_it_does: Scans directories and automatically generates index, barrel, or library files with the necessary export statements. It can be run globally via the command line or integrated via build_runner.
use_when: You want to automate the creation of barrel files (index.dart) for your libraries.
You need to include/exclude specific files or packages using glob expressions.
avoid_when: You prefer manually maintaining all export statements in your project.
strengths: Supports custom include/exclude filters via glob expressions.
Can be run via CLI or integrated with build_runner.
Allows custom output paths, disclaimers, and package-style exports.
weaknesses: Not documented beyond configuration options and basic usage.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally or add to dev_dependencies with build_runner, and configure via index_generator.yaml or pubspec.yaml.
